title: N -W F P Finance Amendment Ordinance 1997

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Finance Amendment Ordinance 1997
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

NORTH﷓WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE FINANCE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER
PROVINCE FINANCE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance further to amend the
North‑West Frontier Province Finance Act, 1994
[Gazette of N.‑W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 22nd March, 1997]
No. Legis.l(14)/73‑III/1810,
dated 22‑3‑1997. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the
North‑West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information.
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the North‑West
Frontier Province Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 7th March, 1997.

[Gazette of N.‑W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 22nd March, 1997]
No. Legis.l(14)/73‑III/1810,
dated 22‑3‑1997. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the
North‑West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information.
2. Amendment of section 2 of
N.‑W.F.P., Act I of 1994.‑In the North West Frontier Province
Finance Act, 1994 (N.‑W.F.P. Act I of 1994) hereinafter referred to as
the said Act, in section 2,‑‑
(i) in clause (g), the word
"and" shall be added at the end; and
(ii) clause (h) shall be deleted.

3. Amendment of section 3 of
